# Webgram IT Solution

> Webgram IT Solution is a Delhi NCR web development company (founded by Vikas Kumar; GST registered and working with clients since 2022; Sangam Vihar, New Delhi) building ecommerce websites, B2B commerce platforms, WooCommerce and Shopify stores, marketplaces and custom web portals for businesses across India.

Contact: +91 7551120242, info@webgramitsolution.in. GSTIN 07CUHPK2017G1ZW. Hours Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00 IST. Pricing is quoted per project after a requirement call; there is no fixed public price list.

## Services

- [Ecommerce Development](https://webgramitsolution.in/solutions/ecommerce-development): Online stores with WooCommerce or Shopify, payments, shipping and SEO.
- [B2B Commerce](https://webgramitsolution.in/solutions/b2b-commerce): Wholesale portals with customer pricing, MOQ, RFQ and ERP-ready integrations.
- [Website Design](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/website-design): Business websites designed for enquiries and search.
- [WooCommerce Development](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/woocommerce): WordPress-based stores.
- [Shopify Development](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/shopify): Hosted Shopify stores.
- [Web Portal Development](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/web-portal-development): Custom portals and dashboards.
- [Website Maintenance](https://webgramitsolution.in/services/website-maintenance): Updates, security and support.

## Case Studies

These are real, live client websites. Figures such as traffic or revenue are not published because clients have not approved them.

### King Sports Management

- Website: https://kingsportsmgt.com/
- Sector: Sports & Athlete Management
- Location: India
- Summary: A premium corporate website for an Indian sports management company covering athlete management, brand partnerships, digital media and sports infrastructure across football, cricket and tennis.
- Delivered: Custom corporate design, Service & athlete sections, SEO-ready page structure, Enquiry-focused layout

### Houskase

- Website: https://houskase.com/
- Sector: D2C Ecommerce Store
- Location: India
- Summary: A high-utility ecommerce experience for household essentials, office supplies, mobile accessories and stationery. Clear collections, combo offers and frictionless product discovery support Houskase’s growing customer base across Delhi and beyond.
- Delivered: WooCommerce storefront, Combo & offer collections, Mobile-first shopping, Payment & shipping setup

### Regal Consulting Group

- Website: https://regalconsultinggroup.ca/
- Sector: Staffing & Recruitment
- Location: Ontario, Canada
- Summary: A professional website for an Ontario workforce solutions firm offering temporary staffing, permanent recruitment, executive search and payroll support for manufacturing and warehousing.
- Delivered: Employer & job-seeker journeys, Industry pages, Registration forms, Clean corporate branding

### Fresh & Bright Cleaners

- Website: https://freshandbright.ca/
- Sector: Local Service Business
- Location: Mississauga, Canada
- Summary: A conversion-focused website for a dry cleaning and laundry business with service listings, free pickup & delivery scheduling and a lead form that books customers directly.
- Delivered: Pickup booking form, Service catalogue, Local SEO setup, Responsive design

### Naval Medical

- Website: https://navalmedical.com/
- Sector: Healthcare & Pharma Distribution
- Location: Lucknow, India
- Summary: An institutional healthcare website for a Lucknow supplier established in 2005, presenting pharmaceuticals, surgical instruments, hospital furniture and GeM procurement support to government and private organisations.
- Delivered: Product & service pages, Institutional sales focus, Trust-building content, Contact & enquiry flow

### My Party Suppliers

- Website: https://mypartysuppliers.com/
- Sector: B2B Wholesale Ecommerce
- Location: Gurgaon, India
- Summary: A wholesale ecommerce website for party decorations and balloons, built for bulk buyers and resellers with category browsing and SEO-friendly product pages.
- Delivered: Wholesale catalogue, Bulk enquiry flow, Category structure, Search-optimised pages

### Chaatewala

- Website: https://chaatewala.com/
- Sector: Importer & Wholesale Supplier
- Location: Delhi, India
- Summary: A B2B website for a Delhi umbrella importer and wholesale supplier, helping gift, bulk and resale buyers explore products and request factory-price orders.
- Delivered: Bulk order focus, Product showcase, Local SEO for Delhi, WhatsApp & call leads

### Mukesh Murtikar

- Website: https://mukeshmurtikar.com/
- Sector: Handicraft Ecommerce
- Location: India
- Summary: An elegant online store for sculptures, statues, idols and wall décor with rich category navigation, offers and a heritage-inspired visual identity.
- Delivered: Ecommerce store design, Category navigation, Offers & coupons, Customer accounts

### Adlite Electricals

- Website: https://www.adliteelectricals.com/
- Sector: Electrical Engineering & Energy
- Location: Faridabad, India
- Summary: A focused industrial website for an electrical engineering company established in 2008, showcasing LT and HT VCB panels, breakers, transformers, EV chargers, renewable-energy EPC and consulting capabilities.
- Delivered: Industrial product catalogue, Energy solution positioning, Enquiry-focused journeys, Responsive company profile

## Technical Architecture

### Ecommerce stores
- Platform: WooCommerce (WordPress, PHP, MySQL) for full ownership and custom logic, or Shopify for hosted stores.
- Payments: Razorpay, PayU or Cashfree with UPI, cards, net banking and COD rules.
- Shipping: Shiprocket integration for rates, labels and tracking; GoKwik for checkout and RTO reduction where needed.
- Messaging: WhatsApp Business API for order updates and lead capture.
- Performance: compressed images, lazy loading, caching/CDN and Core Web Vitals checks before launch.
- SEO: clean URL structure, schema markup (Product, Organization, BreadcrumbList), XML sitemap and canonical tags.

### B2B commerce platforms
- Customer groups with tiered and contract pricing visible only after login.
- Minimum order quantities, bulk/quick order forms and RFQ (request for quote) workflows.
- Dealer and multi-user company accounts, credit terms and GST invoicing.
- ERP, inventory and accounting sync through REST APIs.

### Custom web portals
- Front end: React or Next.js with TypeScript.
- Back end: Node.js and PostgreSQL (including Supabase) with role-based access and row-level security.
- Authentication with email OTP or social sign-in; server-side validation for every write.

### Delivery process
1. Discovery and requirement mapping.
2. Wireframes and UI design.
3. Development and integrations.
4. Testing on phones, tablets and computers.
5. Launch, indexing setup and handover.
6. Ongoing maintenance and support.
